title: The servant proposes workspace revisions as the strategy changes and writes a weekly trader report
problem_register_class: RC4 — Agora: the trading servant does not serve the human trader (SD-AGORA-SERVANT-CORE-CAPABILITIES-20261127 T11)

triggers: Trigger 1 (new strategy version selected): POST /bff/agora/workshops/{workshop_id}/versions/{version_id}/select emits workshop.version.selected and invokes TradingRoomService.on_strategy_version_selected, producing one TradingRoomWorkspaceProposal with changeSummary naming what changed in the strategy and habitRefs.

Trigger 2 (repeated trader edits): TradingRoomService._check_repeated_trader_edits_trigger fires on PATCH /bff/agora/trading-room/workspaces/{workspace_id}/layout and PATCH /bff/agora/trading-room/workspaces/{workspace_id}/widgets/{widget_id} when the same widget is edited >= 3 times within 7 days by user_modified, producing one WidgetRevisionProposal that makes the edit the default.

Trigger 3 (data source freshness or governed active regime transition): TradingRoomService.evaluate_workspace_revision_triggers / _propose_data_or_regime_change produces one WidgetRevisionProposal when a widget data source turns stale, unavailable, or newly fresh, or when a governed active RegimeState (state=active, model_status=approved) transitions on macro or the strategy primary axis, while refusing to trigger on missing, proposed, or candidate regime records.
invariants: At most one pending (status='preview') revision proposal exists per workspace: TradingRoomStore.supersede_pending_proposals_for_workspace marks any earlier preview proposal as superseded whenever a new workspace or widget revision proposal is created.

The servant never edits the active workspace directly: triggers leave dashboardVersion and widget specs unchanged until trader acceptance, and _reject_servant_direct_mutation blocks any direct layout/view/widget mutation carrying a servant actor with 409 OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED.

Trader acceptance or rejection (POST .../accept, POST .../reject) records the decision in the V11 §10.3 changeLog with proposer='trading_servant', decidedBy, status ('accepted' or 'rejected'), reason, and rollbackAvailable.

sections: decisions (owner: agora — offered, taken, accept, modify, reject, shadow, expired)
paper_book (owners: paper_execution, telemetry — fills_count, positions_count, realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, active_capital, exposure)
interventions (owner: evaluation — follow_count, override_count, value_added_score, sample_size)
imitation (owner: policy_learning — candidate_version, trainer_feedback agree/disagree/skip, promotion_blockers)
ac2_sd_section_9_3_weekly_and_on_demand_.owner_attribution_and_number_guard: Every numeric metric across sections, facts, and citations carries non-empty owner, source (source_id), and as_of. Report narrative is rendered through tool_turn.render_answer so any unreferenced model digit is stripped to 〔未引用數字〕 and recorded in number_guard.
ac2_sd_section_9_3_weekly_and_on_demand_.cadence_and_caps: Produced weekly after attribution (trigger='weekly_post_attribution') and on demand via POST /bff/agora/servant/reports or command bar 整理本週報表 (trigger='on_demand'), capped at 3 on-demand reports per trader per day (HTTP 429 trader_report_daily_cap_exceeded on the 4th).

implementation: services/persona/meeting_triggers.py::HttpAttributionPort & attribution_port_from_env — real AttributionPort subclass calling POST /api/attribution/runs and GET /api/attribution/records with env-configured URL and service token or runtime HS256 service JWT.

services/persona/meeting_triggers.py::MeetingTriggers.run_without_persona_cycle & ensure_weekly_attribution_run — requests the weekly attribution run idempotently per (tenant_id, iso_week) via AttributionPort.request_weekly_run even when no persona cycle runs.

services/agora/store.py::AgoraStore.list_active_trader_scopes & services/agora/service.py::AgoraWriteService.list_active_trader_scopes — discovers bounded active (tenant_id, user_id, strategy_id, servant_persona_id) scopes from servant sessions, habit profiles, decision locks, and trader reports.

services/control-plane/bff/agora/servant/turn_worker.py::ServantTurnWorker.maybe_run_weekly_tick & run_weekly_post_attribution_reports (wired in ServantTurnWorker.run_once and scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py) — bounded hourly weekly tick (idempotent per tenant_id + ISO week) invoking MeetingTriggers.run_without_persona_cycle with HttpAttributionPort and producing each active trader's weekly report via TraderReportService.ensure_weekly_report_after_attribution.

ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.recurring_job: ServantTurnWorker.maybe_run_weekly_tick in scripts/run_agora_interaction_worker.py (DEFAULT_WEEKLY_TICK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 3600, WEEKLY_TICK_MAX_TRADER_SCOPES = 50, idempotent per tenant_id + ISO week)
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.cadence: Weekly recurring tick (3600s check interval, fires at most once per tenant + ISO week) producing 1 weekly report per active trader and strategy after weekly attribution + at most 3 on-demand reports per trader per day
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.count_at_hosted_scale: 10 traders x 3 strategies = 30 weekly rows/week (<= 600 KB/week, ~86 KB/day) + <= 30 on-demand rows/day (<= 600 KB/day)
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.growth_per_day: <= 686 KB/day before pruning (0 B on repeat ticks in the same ISO week); steady-state bounded to <= 780 rows (<= 16 MB)
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.cap: 26 weekly reports per trader and strategy (~6 months, TRADER_REPORT_WEEKLY_HISTORY_CAP = 26); 3 on-demand reports per trader per day (TRADER_REPORT_ONDEMAND_DAILY_CAP = 3) with 7-day retention (TRADER_REPORT_ONDEMAND_RETENTION_DAYS = 7)
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.cleanup: AgoraStore.prune_trader_reports on each write + AgoraStore.purge_expired_trader_reports invoked hourly in ServantTurnWorker.maybe_purge
ac4_runtime_budget_cap_cleanup_and_stora.storage_manifest: Registered as bounded schema_table:agora.trader_reports in docs/operations/storage-manifest.json (verified by scripts/check_storage_manifest.py)

ac5_hosted_proof.blocking_condition: This worker cannot deploy to hosted Dev and holds no hosted dev trader credential. Hosted proof requires merging this branch to dev, deploying operator-bff and agora-interaction-worker to hosted dev, and executing the read/write probe below as the dev trader.
procedure_after_deploy: POST /bff/agora/trading-room/workspaces/{workspace_id}/revision-proposals/triggers (or select a new workshop strategy version) as the dev trader and verify GET /bff/agora/trading-room/workspaces/{workspace_id}/revision-proposals returns pending_count=1 while workspace dashboardVersion is unchanged.

POST /bff/agora/servant/reports (or send command-bar quick_task='整理本週報表') as the dev trader and verify GET /bff/agora/servant/reports/{report_id} returns status='completed' with all 9 sections and owner/source/as_of on every metric.
